meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会往你已安装的 Dial 渠道再加一个电话号码（第二或第三个）。每个号码是一条独立的线程式线路，可分别收发短信和 AI 语音通话，回复从收到消息的那个号码发出。
howto.when: 当你已经装好 Dial 渠道，想给 agent 增加第二个或第三个号码时触发。若 Dial 尚未安装，需先运行 /add-dial。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a second or third phone number to your existing Dial channel. Each number is its own threaded line answering SMS and AI voice calls; replies leave from the number that received the message.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Dial is already installed and you want an extra number for the agent (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). If Dial is not installed, run /add-dial first.

say_en.text: Add another number to my Dial channel
List the Dial numbers on this account
say_en.note: Shows numbers already on the account

say_en.text: Make this line strict, only known users can text it
